Penguins Acquire Defenseman Ryan Johnson from Buffalo in Exchange for Caleb Jones and Daniel Laatsch

away.summary: The Penguins bounced back with a 2-1 shootout win over Dallas, with Arturs Silovs playing solidly in net. They acquired defenseman Ryan Johnson from Buffalo in exchange for Caleb Jones and Daniel Laatsch. Pittsburgh is embarking on a four-game road trip starting in Chicago, aiming to build on their recent win after a winless stretch.

doubtful.detail: Nearing return from offseason shoulder injury; participated in full-contact practice but no official return date set; possible game-time decision for Tuesday's game vs Penguins per coach Blashill.

home.summary: The Blackhawks held a moment of silence for Mike Ditka prior to their game against Carolina. Captain Connor Bedard is nearing a return from shoulder injury after full-contact practice, though no official timeline is set. Chicago has lost five of its first six games (1-5-0) and hopes Bedard's return will provide a boost.
